_comment: Floor passages: a cell that moves whoever stops on it to another map. For the maps that
need a way out and have no element to hang a passage off -- the client only lets a
player click what its own map data has (see teleports.json). Nothing is declared to the
client, so the cell looks like any other: put one only where the map's drawing already
A cell that already has an element's passage keeps that one. Several passages that each ask
for a «criterion» can share a cell: the first that holds leads, these before the graph's. This is a file of its own
and not a list in teleports.json because Jondo Studio's passage editor rewrites that
file whole, with only the passages it knows.
THE GM PRISON'S DUNGEON, 105120002, has no element at all. The cage hanging from its
rope, at the right of the big room, stands on cell 333: stepping into it lifts you to
the island, 105119744, on 342 in front of its chest. The rest of the round is in
«removed» lists the cells whose passage from the 2.73 world graph is left out:
The graph is Dofus 2's, and where a place was rebuilt since its old stairs still fire

removed.why: Travelers' Tower, Prisión: the cell its teleporter is used from. Dofus 2's way down to 130155009 moved whoever went to use it there, and the teleporter's choice arrived on the wrong map.
Travelers' Tower: Dofus 2's way back up to the Prisión, on the same cell as its teleporter's.
Travelers' Tower, Prisión: Dofus 2's stairs to the Sala de información, a room its teleporters join in Dofus 3.
Travelers' Tower, Sala de información: Dofus 2's stairs to the Prisión, a room its teleporters join in Dofus 3.

Dramak's Theatre, third room: the arch at the back of the stage (482983), walkable once its five levers are pulled in order (messages.json), into Backstage 1 beside its own way back (cell 487).

Backstage 1 back to the third room of Dramak's Theatre: the 2.73 graph's passage, with its landing moved from 299, the arch, which is not floor until its levers are pulled, to 314, the floor cell in front of it.

Dyna Mine [10,-19], «Attention à la Bête !»: the slab before the trap's gallery opens its grille once the six baits are laid (4680), and the character hides in the trap room until the creature is down (4673); Dofus pour les noobs: «placez votre personnage sur la dalle pour ouvrir la grille et entrez dans la pièce».

Isle of Moon, Tortuga beach [35,5]: the hole in the wrecked ship's hull (cells 255, 269), which Kar Ybe complains everybody takes for a door; the sand below it (284) lets in. The client has no element there and its graph no passage.

Isle of Moon, path of skulls [32,4]: the wreck's doorway under the hanging frame (244, 258); «Entrez dans l'épave de bateau» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Sur les traces des Moonies»). No element outside and no passage in the client's graph.

The luminous vault of the Gúltar family in the cemetery of the Tortured [-14,36] (Dofus pour les noobs: «placer sur la cellule de gauche juste devant le caveau lumineux»), on Bonta's side of «No dejes que tus hijos vaguen»: down to the crypt where Cabotina's spirit waits, from Hata's report until the family is calmed. Brakmar's side keeps the 2.73 graph's passage on the same cell, to the vault of the remains. INFERRED landing: 456, the crypt's floor by its way up.
The same vault once the family is calmed, for whoever left before Cabotina gave the collar: the crypt at peace. INFERRED landing: 456.

The way up out of the Gúltar crypt: its floor opens at the bottom, between cells 469 and 484, and no element is drawn there. Lands on 314 of the cemetery, where the vault of the remains lets one out too.
The way up out of the crypt at peace, the same opening as 178522112's.

Down the frozen lake's crane [-64,-55]: «Dans les profondeurs du lac gelé, parlez à Waldos» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Les joyeux de la couronne»), «Descendez comme pour aller dans le donjon» («Ejército de las sombras» (L'armée des ombres, Dofus pour les noobs)). The planks' end under the crane (cell 199: the last cell the client lets the character walk to; 184 is not reachable), the only way the surface's drawing gives down; no element is drawn on it and the 2.73 graph has no transition into the depths (55836672, 55837184 and 55837696 only lead to one another). Lands at the foot of the depths' winch. INFERRED cells.

Back up the crane from the depths, by the winch on their left edge (the 2.73 graph brings the mine under the same crane up from its cell 448). Lands on the planks next to the way down. INFERRED cells.

The depths' right edge into the cave where Reltux's bag lies: the 2.73 graph's walk from 55836672 to 55837184 leaves on cell 503 (moved to 487, the nearest cell the quest tracker does not cover on the client's screen), and the client's own map data draws no arrow there. Lands by the cave's left wall. INFERRED landing.
And back: the graph's walk from 55837184 to 55836672 leaves on cell 490, the cave's left edge. Lands by the depths' right edge. INFERRED landing.

Dark Vlad's maze [-5,17]: the stone stairs up the tumulus to the Elm Clearing (221249538), the clearing of «Ver a Dark Vlad y morir... o no» and «Letalina». Dofus pour les noobs: «vous rendre au centre de celui-ci dans la clairière du Dark Vlad en [-5,17] en montant les escaliers vers la clairière». The client's map gives the stairs no border; INFERRED cells: 204, the walkable foot of the stairs, and 535, the top of the clearing's own stairs down (536, 549 and 550 are its bottom border back to [-5,17]).

The dragon's tail on Incarnam (122684929), down its stairs to Dark Vlad's island (122685953), «Destinación final» (1471). The client marks the stairs' foot, 391 and 405, with an arrow, its sign of a way out (the 2.73 world graph's cell transition is on 391, and lands on 85, an arrow cell itself). Landing on 114, one step below the island's top step.
As 391: the stairs' foot down to Dark Vlad's island.
As 85: the island's top step up to the dragon's tail.

And back up: the island's top step, 71, 85, 98 and 112, carries the client's arrow (the graph's transition is on 85, landing on 391, the tail's own arrow cell). Landing on 361, the top of the tail's stairs, where the server puts whoever arrives (377, lower down, is not among the cells it counts walkable).
As 85: the island's top step up to the dragon's tail.
As 85: the island's top step up to the dragon's tail.

The Minotoror's island [-42,-17]: the cave in the ruin is the labyrinth's way in («L'entrée se trouve sur l'Île du Minotoror en [-42,-17]», Dofus pour les noobs), and neither the 2.73 graph nor the client's elements hold a passage there. Stepping on 176, the floor before the cave's mouth, leads into the Entrance, the room of the phoenix, its grate (456366) and lever (456367); landing on 289, two steps from its arch.
And back: the arch in the Entrance's right wall, 263 its only walkable cell, out to the island before the cave (204, beside 176).

The Torturer's tavern [5,2] of Sramvil (137367552) had no way in: nothing joins it to the street before it (137366528), and neither map hangs a door element. Its door is the street's arch under the mug sign, up the steps; 359 and 374, the two top cells of those steps under the arch, lead down into the tavern, a cellar whose way in is the walkable corridor running up to its back wall (103-215). «El anillo de Tot» asks you to find it («Encuentra la entrada de la Taberna del Torturador»). INFERRED landing, inside that corridor.
The other top cell of the tavern's steps (see 374): a click on the doorway itself stops the character here.
And out of the tavern: the top of its back corridor, at the wall, leads up to the street, landing at the foot of the arch's steps (403). INFERRED.

Out of the disenchanted thicket: the top of its path, under the light, leads back behind the big tree of the Soft Oak Clearing's exit room, landing by the way in (490835, cell 117). The client's map draws no element there. INFERRED cells.

The Dragon Pig's Den, Second Room: its round door on the right wall (element 472890, cell 306, which is not walked on) leads to the Third Room; the 2.73 graph has the passages of the other empty rooms and not this one. Two cells before the door, 305 and 320. INFERRED arrival, the graph's own for the den's rooms.
The Dragon Pig's Den, Second Room: the other cell before its round door (see 305).

The Dragon Pig's Den, Fourth Room: the way on under its right arch, where the client's map has element 460371 on the floor, leads to the Fifth Room; the 2.73 graph does not have it. INFERRED arrival, the graph's own for the den's rooms.

The Dragon Pig's Den, Sixth Room: the graph's passage sits on cell 488, which the client never walks to (a click there stops on 472), so the way on is the last cell a player reaches before the door. INFERRED arrival, the graph's own for the den's rooms.
The Dragon Pig's Den, Eighth Room: the graph's passage on cell 474 cannot be walked to; 473, beside it, can. INFERRED arrival, the graph's own for the den's rooms.
The Dragon Pig's Den, Tenth Room: a click on the graph's cell 487 stops on 473, so the way on is there. INFERRED arrival, the graph's own for the den's rooms.
The Dragon Pig's Den, Twelfth Room: the graph's cell 501 is not walkable; 487 is the walkable cell next to it. INFERRED cell and arrival.
Behind the totem of [31,6] into the dark clearing, as the 2.73 graph has it, but arriving on 282: the graph's 280 is no walkable cell of the clearing.
The dark clearing's way back to the totem of [31,6]: the 2.73 graph only has the way in, and the clearing has no other exit.

The way out of the Black Tree (221251588): the cave's bright opening at the left of the room's drawing, on cell 380 (the map has no border to walk out of and no element for it), leading back in front of the trunk, [-2,17], cell 290. Dofus pour les noobs, «La campagne hallucinée»: «Trae de vuelta al rebaño» needs the character out of the tree and back at the Coin des Bouftous [2,12]. INFERRED cells. Landing on 317, two steps from the trunk: 290 itself is a sectarian's cell while 2453 is in hand, and 289, 275 and 304 hold the other three.

Behind the tree at the left of [29,7], into the Moon servant's grave of «Examen de paso» (1906, 13038): Dofus pour les noobs, «Il faut aller en [29,7]. Cliquez derrière l'arbre à gauche de la map. Puis cliquez sur la motte de terre devant la tombe». The grave's way out (511038, a map-change mark on 527) lands on 226 by the trunk, and nothing measured leads in, so the cell it lands on is the way in. INFERRED landing, by the way out.

Externam, the Citadel Vestibule [15,14] (subarea 894): the Citadel Entrance's right border leads in (the client's scroll), and the vestibule has no border cell and no element to leave by. Its leftmost floor cell, at the lit opening one comes in by, takes you back to the Entrance's right border (403, by its border cells).

The top hole of the mine's last room (150211588), the one Kroa stands before, drops into Cornelia's prison (150209536) while 2486 is in hand and she is not yet free: the 2.73 graph's passage with its landing moved from 280, off the room's floor, to 243 at the top of it. Dofus pour les noobs («Les derniers d'entre nous»): «Puis le trou en haut (celui devant lequel se trouve Kroa)». INFERRED cell.

The suns of the second room's left-hand arch (elements 505631-505633, graphic 3507) into the third room: the 2.73 graph's passage, with its landing moved from 280, off the third room's floor, to 352, the nearest floor cell at its left-hand gate.
The same arch's other walkable sun (505631) as the 254 one above.
